record.name: Pipedrive
record.one_liner: Pipedrive is a sales CRM and pipeline management software offering a RESTful API for developers to build integrations.

auth.notes: The stateless API is validated against an API token obtained manually from the Pipedrive app.

access.notes: Developers can obtain an API token manually from the Pipedrive app and sign up for a sandbox account.

api_surface.notes: Supports a RESTful API with OpenAPI 3 specifications, webhooks, and official Node.js and PHP client libraries.

buildability.reasoning: Self-service credential generation (API token obtained manually from the app/sandbox) combined with a well-documented RESTful API and official SDKs makes it easy for outside developers to build.

evidence.claim: Mentions building integrations with the API and easy use of webhooks.
Describes the RESTful Pipedrive API which is stateless and validated against an API token obtained manually from the Pipedrive app.
